latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of editor-app: quickly edit and export videos with AI.

- Upload video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) for fast, automated AI editing.
- User-friendly prompts: describe edits (trim pauses, add transitions, etc.) to get polished video output in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic token management with support for anonymous sessions and 100 free credits.
- Cloud render pipeline handles all processing; supports export as 1080p MP4.
- Clear error feedback for unsupported files, large files, credits, and authentication issues.
- Session-based workflow enables iterative edits, previews, and exports.
